captions.detailed: This 3D model features a Maksutov-Cassegrain catadioptric telescope mounted on a computerized single-arm alt-azimuth mount with a tripod. The main optical tube is a short, wide cylinder in white with black end caps, a dark blue corrector lens face, and a small black finder scope on top. It is clamped to a black, single-sided fork arm that rotates on a horizontal altitude axis. The entire arm assembly sits on a black cylindrical computerized base that rotates continuously on a vertical azimuth axis, supported by a silver-and-black three-legged tripod.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Maksutov catadioptric telescope on a computerized single-arm alt-azimuth mount with a tripod. The assembly should feature a white and black telescope tube, a black single-arm mount, and a silver tripod. It must include a continuous azimuth joint at the mount base and a revolute altitude joint connecting the optical tube to the arm.
captions.factory: Construct the model using hierarchical parts. First, build the tripod base with three angled cylindrical legs attached to a central hub. Next, construct the azimuth base using concentric cylinders, and connect it to the tripod. Model the single-arm fork using box and cylinder primitives combined via union operations. Create the optical tube assembly from a main cylinder with colored end caps, a corrector plate, and a small finder scope cylinder. Finally, define a continuous joint for the azimuth axis and a revolute joint for the altitude axis to connect the arm to the base and the telescope tube to the arm, respectively.
